data.name: Jarid
data.gender_notes: Jarid is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew yarad, meaning 'to descend'. In the Bible, this name is used for a descendant of Jesse in the lineage of King David. Jarid represents a strong and unwavering spirit. The name Jarid carries the meaning “Unwavering, steadfast” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jarid usually hope their child will grow to embody unwavering, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of unwavering faith and strength

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jarid total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

This connection to the ancient Israelites and their king who was a man after God's own heart, illustrates the importance of keeping a strong faith and remaining steadfast in our beliefs. This name serves as a reminder that we too, are part of the larger community of believers and that our actions and faith influence the legacy we leave for future generations.
